label: Boyle's law: a closed swim bladder shrinks with depth (pressure p0 + rho g d)
statement_en: With absolute pressure p0 + rho g d (surface pressure p0, water density rho and gravity g as named hypotheses) and P(d) V(d) constant (closed bladder, fixed temperature, quasi-static), the bladder volume at depth d is V(0) p0 / (p0 + rho g d); a closed bladder claiming more volume at depth is ruled out. The v1 '1 atm per 10 m' law is the instance rho g = 10132.5 Pa/m (oneAtmPer10m).

hypotheses.name: Delphi.Hydro.WaterColumn
hypotheses.statement: p0 > 0, rho > 0, g > 0; P(d) = p0 + rho g d
hypotheses.source: hydrostatics; sea water 1025 kg/m^3 and fresh water 998.2 kg/m^3 (NIST) as the engine's pressure scenario cites them; 1 atm per 10 m (Yancey 2020) is the instance rho g = 10132.5 Pa/m

hypotheses.name: hboyle
hypotheses.statement: P(d) V(d) = c for every d >= 0 (closed bladder, fixed temperature, quasi-static; fails for rapid decompression, Kerr et al. 2023)

scope.basis: gas physics (Boyle) in a water column of committed density and gravity; quasi-static only (Kerr et al. 2023)

sources: sim-engine/scenarios/pressure.mjs (rho_w 1025 sea water, 998.2 fresh water NIST, g 9.80665)
observations: v1 (k fixed at 0.1 atm/m) called a correct Boyle volume violated in sea water: 1025 x 9.80665 = 10053 Pa/m < 10132.5 Pa/m, so the real volume sits 0.5 to 1 percent above the v1 bound

lean.source:
/-- **A closed-bladder design claiming more volume at depth than Boyle allows, at the committed ρ and g, is
ruled out.** The P3 constraint of the eliminate pipeline. -/
theorem closed_bladder_rules_out (W : WaterColumn) {V : ℝ → ℝ} {c d : ℝ}
    (hboyle : ∀ d, 0 ≤ d → W.pressure d * V d = c) (hd : 0 ≤ d) {claimed : ℝ} (hclaim : V d = claimed)
    (hbig : V 0 * W.p0 / (W.p0 + W.rho * W.g * d) < claimed) : False :=
  Perturb.closed_bladder_rules_out W.toHydrostatic hboyle hd hclaim hbig

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.Hydro.WaterColumn
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- A water column: surface pressure `p0` (Pa), density `rho` (kg/m^3), gravity `g` (m/s^2). -/
structure WaterColumn where
  p0 : ℝ
  rho : ℝ
  g : ℝ
  p0_pos : 0 < p0
  rho_pos : 0 < rho
  g_pos : 0 < g

constraint_details.relation: V(d) = V(0) p0 / (p0 + ρ_w g d)
constraint_details.canEliminate: a closed-bladder design that keeps neutral buoyancy at depth without secreting gas
